x: Pottinger won the boy's with a score of 23 pts out of a possible 24, and J.Williams won the youth's. Pottinger,incidentally, has done twenty feet in the long-jump - Not too bad for a lad just fifteen years old.
The youth's was won by J.Williams, who beat Dereck Wade by one point. (Dereck was last years boy's winner.) A.Mead was third, another who competed in each event, with a solid performance.
